# UnorderedList

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders a sequence of items with bullet markers.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `ListElementBase`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new UnorderedList(options?: UnorderedListOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`bulletColor`](#bulletcolor): Color for the bullet character
- [`bulletStyle`](#bulletstyle): Bullet glyph.
- [`customBullet`](#custombullet): Custom bullet character (only used when BulletStyle is Custom)
- [`items`](#items): The text items, in order, not counting nested lists.

### `bulletColor`

```typescript
bulletColor: Color
```

Color for the bullet character

Example, from `industry-templates/healthcare/outpatient-appointment-letter`:

```typescript
list.bulletColor = BLUE;
```

Example, from `industry-templates/sales-supply-chain/quotation`:

```typescript
list.bulletColor = FAINT;
```

### `bulletStyle`

```typescript
bulletStyle: BulletStyle
```

Bullet glyph. Accepts `'disc' | 'circle' | 'square' | 'dash' | 'custom'`.

Example, from `code-recipes/tables-lists/lists`:

```typescript
discList.bulletStyle = BulletStyle.Disc;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/tables-lists/lists`:

```typescript
dashList.bulletStyle = BulletStyle.Dash;
```

### `customBullet`

```typescript
customBullet: string
```

Custom bullet character (only used when BulletStyle is Custom)

Example, from `code-recipes/tables-lists/lists`:

```typescript
customList.customBullet = '*';
```

### `items`

```typescript
readonly items: readonly string[]
```

*read-only*

The text items, in order, not counting nested lists. Add items with `addItem`.

> A read-only list: read it or loop over it, but it has no `add` or `push`. To add one, call `addItem()`.

## Methods

- [`addItem`](#additem): Adds a text item to this list
- [`addNestedList`](#addnestedlist): Adds a nested list to this list
- [`getNestedLists`](#getnestedlists): Child lists rendered as nested list content.

### `addItem`

```typescript
addItem(item: string): void
```

Adds a text item to this list

Example:

```typescript
const list = new UnorderedList();
list.addItem('First point');
list.addItem('Second point');
```

### `addNestedList`

```typescript
addNestedList(nestedList: UnorderedList): void
```

Adds a nested list to this list

Example, from `code-recipes/tables-lists/lists`:

```typescript
mainUnordered.addNestedList(nestedCircle);
```

### `getNestedLists`

```typescript
getNestedLists(): readonly UnorderedList[]
```

Child lists rendered as nested list content.
